_note: Second curated sample, chosen deliberately to avoid the three domains that dominated sample 1's failures (acehardware.com's anti-bot walls, agoda.com's login requirement, crunchbase.com's hard Cloudflare block). All READ tasks (WebBench's own most common category, 64.4% of the full set) across 8 distinct, generally lower-bot-protection domains (news, reference, government, recipes, classifieds), to get a real completion-rate number instead of another 0/7-external-blocks run. IDs match the dataset's own row IDs.
